independent_gate.verifier_status: executable rule-based surrogate; external verifier not run

dataset.evaluator_overlap: fixtures are separate from demo cases; policies are shared intentionally
dataset.name: synthetic-heldout-v1

limitations: Recorded responses are not live model inference.
Independent verification comparison is an executable rule-based gate, not a claim of third-party verification.
Three minutes per review is an explicit planning estimate, not observed human labor.

metric_definitions.accepted_output_rate: observed independent-gate accepts divided by held-out cases
metric_definitions.citation_accuracy: observed top citations matching held-out citation labels divided by held-out cases
metric_definitions.duplicate_effect_rate: effects beyond one divided by action scenarios
metric_definitions.estimated_cost_per_accepted_item_usd: estimated provider cost divided by accepted items; recorded backend provider cost is zero, not billed cost
metric_definitions.false_accept_rate: labelled-unsafe rows among observed accepts divided by observed accepts (0 when none accepted)
metric_definitions.first_pass_acceptance: observed accepts requiring neither review nor retry divided by held-out cases
metric_definitions.human_review_count: observed cases routed to human review
metric_definitions.human_review_minutes_estimate: review count times the disclosed three-minute synthetic assumption
metric_definitions.recovery_success: unknown-effect scenarios recovered with exactly one effect divided by such scenarios
metric_definitions.unsupported_conclusion_rate: labelled-unsupported rows among observed accepts divided by labelled-unsupported rows
